author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: M5Stack has introduced the PaperColor, a compact development board built around the ESP32-S3R8 processor and a 4-inch Spectra 6 full-color e-paper display. The platform combines wireless connectivity, onboard sensors, audio hardware, battery operation, and expansion interfaces for low-power IoT and embedded display applications. title: M5Stack PaperColor is an ESP32-S3 dev kit with Spectra 6 e-paper panel
